judged_text: The webhook writes the decrypted keys object to `credential.key` in plaintext, while every read path decrypts credential.key with CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY (the app credential readers in app-store call symmetricDecrypt on credential.key), so synced credentials and locally-created credentials have incompatible encodings stored in the same column. Any credential created or updated via this sync webhook fails to decrypt in the consuming app services, so the synced integration is unusable; the data model has two formats in one column with no discriminator.

adjudication.rationale: In the added webhook (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), the incoming `keys` payload is decrypted with `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and then the resulting object is stored directly into `prisma.credential.{create,update}({ data: { key: keys }})`. However, nothing in this diff shows that "every read path decrypts credential.key with CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY" or that app-store consumers call `symmetricDecrypt(credential.key, ...)`. The app-store service changes shown continue to treat `credential.key` as a parsed object (e.g., Google/Office365/Zoom use zod schemas on the object) and do not decrypt it. Therefore the asserted incompatible encodings / guaranteed failure to decrypt cannot be verified from this diff.
